decisions.reason: As a flagship GIS platform closely aligned with the firm's core geospatial integration capabilities, it fits strongly with existing knowledge, R&D, and standards-based learning, so management would be likely to continue developing and commercializing it.

Mobile field data capture is still closely related to the firm's established GIS and enterprise solution base, and with in-house R&D the firm has enough absorptive capacity to refine it, though it is less central than the platform and therefore somewhat more exposed.

The search extension builds directly on the firm's web-map and component expertise and even showed versioned updating, indicating that the firm can interpret market feedback and improve it within its existing technical trajectory.
